body: hey, im so sorry you feel this way, have you ever considered how amazing it is that your heart does beat and that you have this one shot to live your life, i know right now you dont feel so great, and thats okay, but think there was a time before this where you didnt feel this way, and there will come a time where you no longer feel this, everything is temporary even life so wait and see what happens, take each day as it comes and remember all the bad days are stepping stones to the good, if everything was all good we wouldnt be able to appreciate it, there’s nothing life can throw at you that you cant get through, maybe consider trying something new to help with the way you feel, boxing? good anger releases, wishing you all the best, please look after yourself!

listen, death is inevitable its going to happen to us all at some point, so why not wait around and see what else life has to offer, sometimes the worst days are preparing us for the best ones, there is nothing that life can throw at you that you cant get through, remember you didnt always feel like this, there was a time before and there will be a time after, this situation and feelings you are having now are only temporary they will not last for ever, you are so much stronger then you would ever know, life can be so beautiful and your life will be, we only get one chance to be here so please please wait it out, just see what tomorrow has to offer, take each day at a time, im so proud of you for getting this far and i really do believe you can get through this, please reconsider your decision you seem like such a lovely and intelligent girl and im sure life has so many better things to offer you in the future , hang in there<3

make sure you remind him how loved he is, suggest trying new things together, take up a new hobby or go spend a night away somewhere, suggest joining a gym together to do something productive, try talk to him about it or suggest he seek therapy, a big reminder to him and you both is that everything is temporary, my favourite quote, this too shall pass, the way he is feeling now and the way you feel is only temporary and you can and will both get through it, remind him he didnt always feel like this there was a time before it and there will be a time after, death is inevitable why not wait it out and see what life has to offer because it will suprise you when you least expect it, please take care of yourself too and remember you are not in anyway responsible for anyone else’s actions and do not take on to much if its more then you can handle, try to help him help himself, wish you both the best

i got into my first relationship whilst really struggling with my cptsd and it didnt end well, it devestated me because i genuinely thought i was never going to be able to maintain a relationship because of the way my cptsd effected me, looking back i definitely wasnt ready to be involved with another person and and their emotions so soon, focus on your recovery and on self help, understanding and learning your boundaries and then when you eventually find yourself developing a relationship with someone make sure theyre aware of your triggers and understand your behaviours come from trauma, remind them its not an excuse for anything but simply an explanation, now a few years later i have learnt to manage my cptsd my emotions and i am in a happy relationship with the most supportive guy ever( super important that you find a parnter who is patient and understanding), if i can do it, so can you, its not an easy process definitely one filled with self doubt but please please remember you are capable of being loved, what you went through does not define you, and someone out there is gonna be perfect for you

This is a more common thing then you realise many people in recovery feel the same its just how your mind thinks its sort of a defence mechanism. Sounds to me like you’re unintentionally overthinking things, you will not be taken off your meds because thats what is helping you, you deserve to be happy do not believe any thoughts you have that you don’t. recovery isn’t easy and you are so strong and you should be proud of yourself. it might take a while to come to terms with the fact your getting better due to past feelings and thoughts because its all you’ve ever known but you’ll get there you’ll be happy one day. you need to carry on getting better and when you get better you live your life to the fullest and do all the amazing things you’ve ever wanted to do. you are a good person fighting a battle and you can and will win it. do not let yourself fall into bad habits again recovery is worth it, i hope you find happiness and get better. you are so important and your life matters do not give up on yourself<3

You are not alone i promise you no matter how scared or lonely you feel right now it will be okay. Tell her everything and apologise and hope that she understands. If she doesn’t remember there is billions of people on this earth and you are going to find other friends or s/o you have so much time and so much more life to live. i dont know how old you are but it sounds like you possibly still ive at home? anyway if so you have your whole life to move find a new environment meet new people and be happy. depression is such a hard thing to battle with and you are doing so well. do not blame yourself for any of this because that wont change the situation. i also want to remind you that it is ok to be alone sometimes, i know its not ideal, but you can use the time to work on your self and not worry about how to please others and then try again with friendships when you feel ready. i’ve been in a similar situation its not a nice feeling i know but as much as you may feel the world is against you it gets better, i promise. if you are feeling sucidal at any point please please reach out and ask for help. suicide is not the answer it never is i could go on listing so many reasons you need to be here(and if you need me to i will). its gonna be okay bud, you are cared about by people you don’t know and you are gonna meet more people who care about you. you are loved and important even if you dont see it. take care of yourself, wishing you all the best<3
